provenance.independence: Separate agent/context from both translators; did not draft, polish or modify either translation. Independently read all catalogue values and context sidecars and derived parser/format/width results here.

translator.source: Delegation brief; history not independently queried or inferred from defaults

findings.current_text: Notifications, {count, plural, one {{countText} non lue} many {{countText} de non-lues} other {{countText} non lues}}
findings.proposed_text: Notifications, {count, plural, one {{countText} non lue} many {{countText} de notifications non lues} other {{countText} non lues}}
findings.reason: The many branch produces “1000000 de non-lues”: a stilted substantivized participle; name the omitted noun after de while retaining the numeric selector and countText.
findings.evidence: Real IntlMessageFormat output at count=1000000: Notifications, 1000000 de non-lues
findings.disposition: proposed; not edited; non-blocking idiom finding

findings.reason: Keep the idiomatic wording pending a rendered narrow-column check: now is 3 code points versus à l’instant at 11; static expansion is a width risk, not demonstrated clipping.
findings.evidence: Real formatter output measured with JS [...text].length: 3 -> 11; context calls this a very short label in a narrow time column.
findings.disposition: rendered-fit check assigned to design/QA; no screenshot or overflow claim

observations: Three locale-scoped fr cognate IDENTICAL_OK allowances are present at guard execution; no outstanding guard repair and no test edits by this auditor.
row.updated_ago neutral phrasing verified against caller clock/date/duration variants.
row.ask_options zero case is not emitted by caller; numeric value must be >0.
String-typed simple count arguments preserved without introducing numeric selectors.

width_screen.metric: Unicode code points, not pixels or terminal cells
